inputs.coverage: Published convex light-curve model 1695. Convex light-curve reconstruction with approximate thermal size: 58.95 km effective diameter (catalog ±1.24 km; additional shape and thermal-model uncertainty). The thermal size is used as a volume-scale approximation. The grid marks unavailable imagery; rotational phase is illustrative. The convex inversion resolves the broad shape; craters and concavities are unresolved. Other published pole solutions remain possible.
